items.title: Outlook: Change the organizer of a meeting
items.description: Transfer ownership of a meeting or recurring meeting series to another person in your organization. The new organizer must accept the transfer before it is completed. This helps maintain continuity for long-running meetings while preserving the existing event for attendees. Available in Outlook for Windows and web and Teams calendar.

items.title: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
items.description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user. Private tasks cannot be shared or assigned to others, and existing tasks continue to work and appear alongside them.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source
items.description: eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
items.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
items.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
items.description: Users are now able to temporarily pause all notifications.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
items.description: Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in Teams meetings and events
items.description: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event. Users defined here will have access to the controls in 'Manage What Attendees See' and the ‘Green Room'.

items.title: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
items.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
items.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Data – Granular access policy controls for custom attributes
items.description: We are introducing enhanced access policy management for Organizational Data in Microsoft 365. This update enables admins to release custom attributes to specific users or groups, rather than broadly to all employees or all managers. This provides a more conservative default approach for managing sensitive organizational data, while also supporting staged rollout of new attributes. Additionally, admins can configure whether leaders and managers are permitted to share non-public data with Workfor

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint thumbnail previews
items.description: Microsoft Teams on desktop now shows rich link previews when you share SharePoint pages. Links automatically expand into a visually appealing card with a thumbnail image and page description, making it easier to understand and engage with shared SharePoint content directly in Teams.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
items.description: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
items.description: File Quarantine action in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive, enables stronger, immediate protection for sensitive data. When a DLP policy is triggered, the File Quarantine action automatically moves the file to a restricted, admin‑controlled & defined quarantine location—instantly removing access for all users while preserving the file for review and investigation. This capability helps organizations contain data‑exposure risks, prevents further sharing or misuse, and delivers a

items.title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
items.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
items.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

Engage with agents as a group or privately, with zero state prompts and history support for seamless interactions.
